description: This source file defines the 'LicenseManagerLinuxSubscriptionsClient' class in the Aws\LicenseManagerLinuxSubscriptions namespace, which is used to interact with the AWS License Manager Linux Subscriptions service. It primarily contains method annotations for various API calls related to subscription management, registration, listing, tagging, and updating service settings.
